notes: Scoped the Windows dark form-control fix to the Automation Hub so game-page controls keep their original rendering.
Kept dropdown, select, and input values readable on Windows without globally changing Pockie Ninja form controls.

sections.title: Improvements
items: Scoped dark select/input/textarea styling to the Automation Hub application shell instead of applying it globally.
Preserved the Windows form-control readability fix while keeping native game-page controls isolated.

sections.title: Fixes
items: Fixed Automation Hub form-control styling leaking into the Pockie Ninja game page and altering native dropdown rendering.
